rootCauseAnalysis.failurePoint: UC fix-rescue-triage-feature-selfserve-frictionless-o had a truncated description (same text as the name) and implementation_status='in_progress' with no clear spec for dev to implement
rootCauseAnalysis.why: The UC was created by a rescue-triage flow that copied the PM triage task title as both name and description, leaving no concrete spec for the dev agent to act on. The implementation_status was 'in_progress' but no task was actively working on it.
rootCauseAnalysis.fix: Updated the UC description with a concrete 4-point spec (name+email+phone form, no email verification gate, /dashboard with dismissable FUB connect prompt, no payment required) and reset implementation_status to 'not_started' so the orchestrator can spawn a dev task

taskSpec.what: Update use_cases table in PostgreSQL openclaw DB: set description to 4-point frictionless onboarding spec, set implementation_status to 'not_started' for UC id=fix-rescue-triage-feature-selfserve-frictionless-o
taskSpec.verify: psql query confirming description updated and status='not_started'
taskSpec.boundaries: No code changes needed — existing trial-signup route already has email_verified=true (no gate), redirects to /dashboard/onboarding, no payment required. Dashboard already has OnboardingWizardLauncher (dismissable). This is a DB-only spec update.
